events.name: New York Jets at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw a 39-yard touchdown pass to Aaron Dobson on the game's first series before both offenses played as sloppily as the second-half weather, and the New England Patriots got by the New York Jets 13-10 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots pick off Geno 3 times in 4th, sink Jets

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Julio Jones hauled in 11 passes for 182 yards, including an 81-yard touchdown, and the Atlanta Falcons held on for their first win of the season, 31-24 over the St. Louis Rams on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jones' 182 yards, TD lift Falcons past Rams

headlines.description: Rookie EJ Manuel hit Stevie Johnson for a 2-yard touchdown pass with 2 seconds left to lead the Buffalo Bills to a 24-23 win over the Carolina Panthers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills edge Panthers with TD in final seconds

headlines.description: Jay Cutler threw a 16-yard touchdown pass to Martellus Bennett with 10 seconds left to lead the Chicago Bears to a 31-30 victory over the Minnesota Vikings on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bears edge Vikes on Cutler's TD to Bennett

events.name: Washington Redskins at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw for a career-high 480 yards and four touchdowns and the Green Bay Packers used a big first half against the Washington Redskins to win their home opener 38-20 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers passes for 480 yards, 4 TDs in rout

headlines.description: Ryan Tannehill threw for 319 yards and one touchdown Sunday, and the Dolphins defense held off yet another Colts' comeback bid for a 24-20 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins hold off Colts' rally to win in Indy

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Alex Smith threw for 223 yards and two touchdowns, and the Kansas City Chiefs defense held when it needed to in the fourth quarter for a 17-16 victory over the Dallas Cowboys on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs hold off Cowboys, improve to 2-0

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: Philip Rivers threw three touchdown passes to Eddie Royal, and Nick Novak kicked a 46-yard field goal with 7 seconds left to lead the San Diego Chargers past the Philadelphia Eagles 33-30 on Sunday, spoiling Chip Kelly's home debut.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rivers, Chargers stun Eagles on last-minute FG

headlines.description: The Baltimore Ravens sacked Brandon Weeden five times before finally knocking him out of the game in the fourth quarter of a 14-6 victory on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens ride D past Browns; Weeden hurt

headlines.description: Rookie DeAndre Hopkins grabbed a 3-yard touchdown pass in overtime and the Houston Texans rallied for a 30-24 win over the Tennessee Titans on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hopkins' TD in OT caps Texans' wild rally

headlines.description: A pass interference penalty against Bill Bentley set up Rashard Mendenhall's 1-yard touchdown run with 1:59 to play Sunday and Arizona beat the Detroit Lions 25-21 in Bruce Arians' home debut as Cardinals coach.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cards top Lions as Arians wins home debut

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Garrett Hartley kicked a 27-yard field goal as time expired to give the New Orleans Saints a weather-delayed 16-14 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: FG helps Saints overcome rain, sloppy Bucs
McFadden helps Raiders run over Jaguars

events.name: Denver Broncos at New York Giants

headlines.description: Peyton Manning again beat younger brother Eli, throwing two touchdown passes in leading the Denver Broncos past the New York Giants 41-23 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Peyton's Broncos get the best of Eli, Giants

headlines.description: Seahawks ride Lynch to 29-3 blowout of 49ers
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks swamp Niners after storm delay

headlines.description: Rookie Bernard leads Bengals over Steelers 20-10
headlines.shortLinkText: Bernard's 2 TDs lead Bengals past Steelers
